newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Gunmen kill another Shi'ite activist in Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill another Shi'ite activist in Pakistan.

text.p: Two gunmen shot dead a Shi'ite Moslem activist on Monday, the latest in a spate of sectarian attacks ahead of a Shi'ite festival, police said.

They said two young men had gone to the home of Shukar Din, a local official of the Shi'ite Tehrik-i-Jafria Pakistan (TJP), in a western district of the Punjab provincial capital Lahore and shot him when he answered the door. The gunmen escaped.
Din was taken to hospital, where he died.

The attack occurred a few hours after Shi'ite and Sunni Moslem religious leaders met Punjab provincial government officials to discuss how to keep the peace during the Shi'ite mourning month of Muharram, which starts on Friday.
At least 69 people have been killed this year in a longstanding feud between Sunni and Shi'ite militants.
